batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b DP Nannes

batting.name: Mohammad Ashraful
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Mohammad Ashraful b SL Malinga

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c Mohammad Ashraful b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c AM Nayar b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: superb shot, and Harbhajan shows just why he wanted the strike, fulltoss outside off, and lofted over point with an open face. good end to the innings
this time they get two, Dhawal Kulkarni, the non-striker is quick to get Harbhajan back to strike, it was hit straight to long-off again
Malinga has been sacrificed, hit straight down to long-off, and Malinga has to run back to the non-striker's end and is clearly short

great drama, slower ball, beats Harbhajan, Karthik throws the stumps down, but Harbhajan is in, and they steal an overthrow, Karthik goes for the non-striker's end too, and misses, they go for the second overthrow, Harbhajan is short of the ground at striker's end, but Karthik forgets to completely uproot the stumps
fulltoss outside off stump, Harbhajan slashes and misses
Harbhajan walks across and down the track, Sangwan goes wide of off and perhaps too wide
gets Rahane with a slower offcutter, just back of a lnegth, Rahane makes room, goes for extra cover, but is early into the shot, lobbing it straight to AB
length ball this time, Harbhajan makes room, and hits it to the right of extra cover, and beats sweeper-cover too, superb shot
back of a length again, 141ks, and played with an open face towards sweeper-cover
length ball, on the stumps, makes room and plays it down to long-off
too good for Shah, bouncer, 137ks, sharper than how it reads, Shah is clearly minutes late into the pull, and lobs it to the right of the bowler, easy catch
upper-cut, makes room again, and Nannes pulls the length back, hit straight towards Sangwan
superb shot again from Rahane, and help from Sangwan at third man, played with an open face, it is flying to right of Sangwan, who misses it on the dive
chipped away over midwicket, easy two, length ball again
tries a reverse scoop over the keeper, and misses completely
fifty for Rahane, back of a length, outside off, and dabbed away towards point
length ball, wide outside off, and Rahane hands it the treatment, lofts it with an open face, over sweeper-cover, top shot
gets away with that, leg-side fulltoss and Pinal picks out the fine leg
wide outside the off stump, length ball, and driven to right of sweeper-cover
Salvi tries a slower ball, but is too wide outside off
this one stops on Rahane, who has stepped down, but he manages to lob it over the bowler and get a single
short again, Rahane rocks back early and pulls over midwicket
tossed up, and almost yorks Rahane
back of a length, punched off the back foot to the left of Mishra
first six of the match, and what a shot it is, he takes half a step down, sees Mishra has shortened the length, and Rahane goes over extra cover, flat and powerfully
and goes for four first ball, short and into the leg side, Rahane steps out, makes room, and slogs it to midwicket for four
slower delivery again, outside off, and dabbed towards point
yorker, there is time to dig it out, and he plays it towards square leg for one
slower offcutter this time, Rahane slogs, but can't beat midwicket
slower legcutter again, outside off, and Pinal plays with soft hands and takes a single to cover
slog sweep from way outside off, superb improvisation, that's a much needed boundary as he clears midwicket easily
length ball on the stumps, played with soft hands towards deep backward square and they scamper through for two
turned away towards fine leg, from in front of middle stump, just a single
back of a length again, outside off, and played with an open face towards point
back of a length, just outside off, tapped at his feet and a single stolen
angled into the pads, and played down to fine leg

he has given him, this one straightened after pitching within the stumps, Nayar walks across a bit, is surprised by the inwards movement, is caught in front of stumps, and the height is good too - good call
tucks him up with a short delivery that nips back in, played off the hip for one
and superb running again, turned around the corner to the right of fine leg, not enough power on the shot again, and an easy couple in the end - despite a direct hit
slower offcutter this time, pitches leg, and turns towards off, Nayar defends off the back foot
gets off the mark right away, excellent placement and running, turns it around the corner, knows it doesn't have enough power behind it, and comes through for a couple

and he finally gets him with a slower legcutter, this time Sachin looks to go extra cover, premeditates again, Bhatia slips in one at 95ks, and Tendulkar misses completely and the off stump is fatally exposed
looks for the scoop again, Bhatia sees it again, and stays short and outside off, and hits him in the thigh
looks for the scoop, Bhatia sees it, and goes short and wide, and beats him

beats batsman, keeper, third man and fine leg with a slower ball. Rahane looks the silliest after having wafted at it minutes before it came, it bounced short of Karthik and went through his legs, and neither third man nor fine leg who ran towards it could prevent the boundary
length ball, on the off stump, and played down to long-off
inside edge for four, looks to cut, again it's not short enough, and he gets the underside edge, and beats Karthik too
pitched outside leg, beats Rahane's defence and appeals unsuccessfully for the lbw. One leg-bye nonetheless
slower ball, Tendulkar leans back to cut, but Sehwag makes a superb diving save at point
beats him with an angled delivery, Sachin looks to cut, but it is not short enough
steps out again, hits straight, Mishra gets a hand to it, and it's a single down to long-on
miscues a loft, but the good thing is he is going down straight, and it falls safe, Dilshan runs from long-off, gets a hand to it, but can't save the boundary
this is short, and he rocks back and pulls it towards midwicket
superb shot, not too short, But Rahane sees it early, rocks back, and cuts it fiercely
steps out again, Mishra fires it down the leg side, and a single into the on side
top shot, Sachin steps down, gets to the pitch of the ball, and lofts it over extra cover. Smooth
again stays back of a length, just outside off, punched down to long-off for one
another delivery back of a length, and played straight to square leg
length ball, outside off, driven on the up, and played straight towards cover
back of a length, on the off stump, moving away a bit, and defended back to the bowler
inside edge saves him on that lbw, slower ball, fools him on the drive
back of a length, outside off, and turned to wide of long-on
leading edge as Rahane turns the bat to leg too early, but the edge is not strong enough to carry to Mishra
short and wide, played square of third man and they get two
steps out, is beaten in the flight, but delays his drive, doesn't go for a powerful one, and gets a single to wide of cover
angled into the pads, and turned around the corner

doesn't read the googly, but perhaps is hit just outside off and escapes the lbw appeal, and Tendulkar is also alert to take a second leg-bye too, off an overthrow after the fielder hits the stumps direct
tossed up, on the off stump, and played back to the bowler
deftness followed by brutality, full ball, and driven powerfully down the ground, Dilshan is there at long-on but he can move only four to five steps before the ball beats his dive - it was so fast
another slower ball, and a smart shot from Tendulkar, waits for it, cuts this fullish delivery, fine of short third man, for four
another slower ball, too full, and played wristily down to long-on
just back of a length, outside off, and hit down the ground for one
slower delivery, 92ks, just outside off, and played straight towards cover
length ball, just outside off, punched wide of cover
starts off with a leg-side wide, which also yields a bye
googly tried, coming in from around the off stump, but doesn't beat Tendulkar who takes a single to long-on
slower to Rahane, on the stumps, and he dabs it into the on side
dropped, and only because it's AB, Tendulkar makes room, goes inside-out, AB flies to his right, no other fielder would have got a hand to it
slower, on the pads, played towards short fine, and they go for the single, Salvi goes for the non-striker's end and misses but they choose against the overthrow
thrown up this time, just outside off, and played towards sweeper-cover
short and into the pads, Tendulkar makes room, and clears midwicket fieldsman, well placed
and he will start with a no-ball, down the leg side, Sachin paddles but doesn't beat short fine leg

this time the aerial shot works, it is a length ball on the leg stump, and Rahane clears his front leg and goes over midwicket, putting in it just enough to clear the fielder and roll along to the boundary
pitches it up now, just outside off, and defended back towards the bowler
short, slow, and Rahane helps himself to four to the wide open space at deep backward square leg
a touch slower this time, Rahane is early into the drive, and checks the shot, playing it back towards the bowler
lucky Rahane, this is pitched up, on the stumps, and Rahane goes for the wild slog, which goes to the right of Bhatia at square leg. He goes one-handed, and drops it
another wide down the leg side
pitched on the leg stump, length ball, and turned around the corner, smartly, for two runs wide of fine leg
full, just outside off, Tendulkar goes for the drive, is early into the shot, and hence the ball goes mid-off as opposed to cover
short, angled across, and steered away to third man
Gambhir misfields at cover and allows Tendulkar a single, this was a similar punch, Gambhir went one-handed and missed completely
back of a length, angled across, Sachin punches it, but can't beat cover
fuller, and angled across, and defended into the covers
tucks Sachin up, with one that rises from just back of a length, and on the leg stump
accurate delivery again, pitches off, shapes in a touch, and played straight to square leg. But for the wide, a wicket-maiden
pitches it up now, around the middle stump, and defended back to the bowler
and gets a fiery bouncer first up, pitched middle of the track, on the middle stump, no where to hide and Rahane ducks in, a touch too late
and ends Ashraful's uncomfortable stay, it's a simple, straight delivery actually, pitching off and angling away, Ashraful defends down the wrong line and gets the outside edge
finds the length and line, not drivable, on off stump, and angling away, defended with an open face
big wide, down the leg side, Karthik does well - 6 wides already
starts off with a wide loosener, lucky not to be punished as Ashraful misses out on the drive
another single stolen, again the ball nipped back from outside off, cramping Ashraful up, but they run off the inside edge that hasn't travelled too far off the pitch
nips back in from around the off stump, Sachin gets an inside edge onto the pad, and they run through well
short and wide, and Tendulkar misses on the square cut - it's so wide
just back of a length, on the stumps, and punched back to the bowler
a nothing shot, looks to pull a ball that is far too full, gets a top-edge, which lobs over the bowler, and short of mid-off
beaten outside off, length ball, just outside off, the ball swings away, no feet movement, lucky not to get an edge
length ball, outside off, Ashraful plays from where he stands, and hits straight towards cover
on the pads again, but Ashraful misses out and gets a leg-bye
tries a short one again, but is misdirected down the leg side
full, a yorker, angling across the batsman, and beats the outside edge
and on target, on a length, middle stump, and defended by Ashraful

it's Nannes's turn to make a comeback, and it's Nannes's bounce that claims Duminy. Back of a length, just outside off, Duminy looks to steer it, but the extra bounce takes the edge through to Karthik
what a comeback from Duminy, it's a back-foot punch, almost in the Tendulkar punch, taking a length ball from in front of stumps, and just playing a check-drive, straight down the ground for four
another sharp bouncer, Duminy goes for the pull, but is surprised by the bounce, and the head falls away, and the ball takes the top edge, luckily for him over the keeper
short, but not enough width, and he gets a bottom edge while going for the cut
lovely straight drive, sees the ball is a touch slower, takes half a step down, to get close to the pitch, and presents it the full face, almost a check-drive, and it beats mid-off
fuller and wider, but Sachin drives it straight to square-cover
lovely shot, just leans into the drive and presents the full face, again not drivable length, but he stretches and meets the ball on the up, and the ball goes crashing through the covers
gets the length right, just short of drivable, outside off, and played with an open face towards point
swinging, full, and beating Tendulkar's outside edge, just outside off
misses out perhaps, length ball, angling down the pads, but gets only his pad through to the wicketkeeper
this is even sharper, again lifting it from just back of a length, just outside the off stump too, and beats Duminy on the defence
good bounce, just back of a length, but tucks him up with the lift, Tendulkar drops it at his feet and runs through, well run
on the stumps this time, holding its line, and Tendulkar flicks it towards square leg
that's a touch harsh, pitched just outside off, angling away, and swings away late, but is called wide
pitches off, angling in, Duminy goes across and plays it down to fine leg

he gets it on target, and how. Smartly bowled this time, pitched up, and instead of swinging away, taking it in with the angle, pitched just outside off, hit him in front of off, and headed towards the stumps. Another golden duck
goes further up, but is still wide, and the swing carries it farther
digs it in short and wide, and the ball  moves away after pitching
Mishra has finished it as if nothing has happened in the last three overs, steps down, gets to the pitch, and chips it over midwicket for a big six - no power, all timing. Thanks for coming Mumbai
that should end it, too short, Mishra, looking to step down, stays back, and has a wide off-side field to choose from, goes cover and finds the gap
thrown up, chipped over midwicket coolly for two
superb over, thrown up again, around the off stump, and Karthik defends off the back foot. Harbhajan has turned the game around, but not enough perhaps. Malinga has been bowled out
throws it up, a bit too short, outside off, and played down towards mid-on for one

Harbhajan is on a hat-trick again! Delhi are falling apart. Big offbreak, and goes through the big gate between bat and pad. Expecting a doosra perhaps? In the end he defends outside the line and presents the stumps wide open.

and he has chipped it straight to deep midwicket, are we in for another thriller? this one was thrown up on the off stump, AB went for the impulsive chip, connecting it too well and the ball carries to the Nayar
full and straight, and defended back to the bowler
and throws it up now, and turns it down the leg side
If that missed run-out wasn't the decisive moment this one surely is? Gets an edge with a topspinner again, it flies between keeper and slip, Rahane standing too wide

another flighted delivery, and almost runs AB out, Bhatia doesn't go for the run because it has gone straight to extra cover, where Dhawal  doesn't pick up the ball cleanly and AB is back. Decisive moment?
tosses it up, and played straight to mid-on
hurries him up with a quicker one, and played back towards the bowler
thrown up now, gets across and chips it into the leg side
floated in, short, and played towards midwicket
thrown up outside off, and driven straight down the ground
thrown up, slower, turned away into the leg side

big shout, superbly bowled again, the topspinner again, beats Bhatia's outside edge, all the close-in fielders go up, and Harbhajan thinks he has got him, but there is daylight between bat and ball, replays show
that's close, spinning in sharply towards the middle stump, and Ab gets his bat down in time, playing it towards square leg
that's two big wickets in two balls, the topspinner beats Sehwag, who doesn't pick it, is late into the shot, and plays inside the line. The off stump goes for a walk, Harbhajan is on a hat-trick
gets a wicket now, thrown up, the doosra, Dilshan goes for the slog-sweep, goes too square, and gets the top edge, a skier is well held by Pinal
dropped, short and smashed back the bowler, Harbhajan stretches his hand out, but it doesn't stick. Sehwag gets to his fifty
slower ball, and Dilshan clears his leg and goes down the ground again, beats wide long-off easily, and we are cantering towards an end
goes for the yorker, but it's a low fulltoss again, Dilshan clears the front leg, hits down the ground, and beats mid-on easily
no-ball, free-hit time... was well bowled though, swinging away and beating Dilshan outside off
another slower ball, length ball, and played towards midwicket, another dot
slower ball, outside off, yorker still, and beats Dilshan
gets the yorker right this time, dot ball into the covers
faster they come, faster they go, goes for the yorker, but it's a fulltoss, and what timing for Dislhan, no back lift, just a flick of the wrists, and clears deep backward square
thrown up, on the stumps, and played for an easy single towards long-off
fired into the pads, and played down to long-on
Sehwag looks unstoppable bow, steps down, Jayasuriya pulls the length back, Sehwag is nowhere near it, still goes with the shot, straight, and clears long-on with ease
continues over the wicket, and Dilshan dabs it towards cover for one
fired into the pads, Sehwag goes for the reverse sweep, lucky it doesn't carry to point
lovely shot, perfect, this is a half-volley on off stump, Sehwag makes room and clears extra cover easily, inside-out and on the mark
full, goes for the yorker, but it's too full, but too fast too, and is played towards midwicket
slower short ball, and Dilshan is too early into the pull
lovely hook shot, it's a touch slower, 137ks, that means Dilshan gets the timing right, and clears deep backward square easily
overpitched, outside off, driven powerfully, Rahane at point gets a hand to it, and saves four
full, goes for the yorker, and fires it down the leg side
gets it to get big from back of a length, Sehwag stands tall, and plays it down towards fine leg

starts off with a slower ball, Gambhir sees it, steps down, but it's the off cutter, takes the thick edge, and the ball skied between keeper and third man, both the fielders converging, Ashraful running in calls for it, and takes a good diving catch, avoiding Pinal Shah
he clips it off his pads to fine leg
makes room and slaps it straight to cover
chips down the track and lofts him inside out to deep extra cover
he shuffles across his stumps and withdraws the shot, decides to let it go down the leg side
down the leg side again, he paddles it to fine leg
slides it wide down the leg side and it beats the keeper and runs away to fine leg
makes room and chops it back to the bowler, he was looking to work it to the on side
turned to square leg
no fault of Nayar's this time, this is brilliance, it was back of a length, outside off, Sehwag takes a half-step forward, and pulls it, bisecting long-on and deep midwicket
quick single, played straight towards midwicket in the circle
poor bowling, short, on the pads, and Gambhir rocks back and pulls it to deep midwicket
length ball, on the pads, and defended back to the bowler
angled into the pads, and turned away wide of midwicket
superb shot, gentle half-volley, and lofted straight over his head, flat and fast too, clearing the boundary easily, just stands and admires the shot
thrown up on off stump, turning away sharply, and left alone
good shot, good running, turned away softly between deep backward square and midwicket, and they run two
that is risky, backing away to hit a ball pitched off, turning in, and is eventually cramped up and gets an underside edge
steps out, gets to the pitch, and hits down to long-on
Gambhir tries two shots and connects on none, first the paddle, but Harbhajan bowls it wide of off, then he looks to run it down and misses
thrown up, length ball, turning in towards off stump, and played towards an open face
leading edge as Gambhir looks to turn it to leg too early, but it doesn't carry to Nayar
slower, fuller, on the off stump, played back to the bowler
goes fine leg again, not much power this time, but ordinary bowling given there is no fine leg, this one too was pitched outside leg
smart batting, there is no fine leg, so he waits on a short delivery, and just turns it around the corner, four easy runs
back of a length, outside off, and swatted away towards long-on
bowls a half-volley outside off, Sehwag goes for too much power, it goes off the splice of the bat and clears extra cover
Gambhir looks to cut from just outside off, the ball gets a bit big on him and he ends up playing towards cover as opposed to point
full, into the pads, and dabbed towards midwicket for one
overspinner, Gambhir drops and runs, Rahane runs in quickly from cover, but fails to collect before he throws, else this would have been interesting
sharp offbreak, flat, beats a poke from Gambhir outside off
makes room and cuts from in front of middle stump for one to sweeper-cover
thrown up, just outside off, and defended by Sehwag. Surprising
back of a length, outside off, cut away to third man, end of an expensive over
another four, he is getting stuck into Kulkarni, full, into the pads, Sehwag obliges, goes midwicket, in the air, easy four runs
that's better bowling, fuller, angling into the stumps, and defended in front of off stump
this is more convincing, back of a lnegth, outside off, Sehwag stands tall again, and crashes it through the covers
length ball, Sehwag stands tall and goes over midwicket - safe shot, although it goes way up in the air, lands safely and rolls into the boundary
short, angling away, and dabbed away towards point for one
slower ball, 126ks, full on the pads, and flicked away to deep backward square
back of a length, wide, Sehwag plays off the front foot, in the air, but gets it wide of point
thrown wide outside off, and played down to third man for one
full, on the pads, and flicked away towards deep backward square, Sehwag off the mark
length ball, on the stumps, swinging in, and played down to mid-on for one
short, angling across, Gambhir opens his face on it, but can't beat point
short, angling across, cut away, point fumbles and they come through for one
perfect cover-drive, length ball, angling across, he leans in and presents it the face of the bat, beats the cover field. Beautiful shot
beats Gambhir with a ball angled across his body. He can't walk down because the keeper is up

gone, what a way to go, amde room again, threw his bat at it - literally - as it came out of his hand and flew towards fine leg. No one catches the bat, but the ball flies off the splice towards extra cover where Ashraful takes a simple catch
length ball, makes room, and smashes it back to the bowler
and he has prodded it for a six! Literally. Walks down the track, turns it into a length delivery, and frees his arms. No follow-through. Just a check loft, over long-on
pulls the length back a touch, on the off stump, dabbed away towards point, but NO is the early call
gentle pace, length ball, angling into the pads, and lofted over midwicket, simple
angling in towards his pads, and he misses out on a big one
length ball, on off stump, dabbed towards point and one run
overpitched, just outside off, and played to right of mid-off for one
what a way to start, loopy fulltoss, slightly above waist high, Warner doesn't get the no-ball call but hits it for four all right, to midiwcket
sharp single, back of a length, played to extra cover and called early
runs it down to third man this time, smart batting
another four and Gambhir is going after Kulkarni, pitched up, on the pads, Gambhir clears the front leg and goes straight down the ground, in the air
looks to run it for a single around the corner, but misses, almost on the run
Gambhir wants to bully Kulkarni, walks down to him, Kulkarni oulls the length back, but Gambhir still manages to hit into the gap towards deep backward square
Warner goes for the big pull right away, but the ball is too full for the shot, lucky for Warner that it doesn't carry to midwicket
slower bouncer, and this time Gambhir sees it coming, waits for it, rocks back and pulls it over square leg
that's a fast bouncer, 144ks, in Gambhir's face, who pulls it and is way too late in the shot
another full and fast delivery, around off stump, and Warner slashes at it, gets a thick outside edge, towards third man
back of a length again, swinging into the pads, and dabbed into the on side for one
full and fast, driven away with the open face, but can't beat cover
good bounce, good running. tucks him with a back-of-a-length delivery, Gambhir plays down to third man, where a slight fumble enables him to get back for two
